description: Search Skiplagged for flight fares by route, batch of routes, pasted search URLs, or a flexible-date price calendar. Returns prices, airlines, flight numbers, layovers, hidden-city flags and booking providers.

adults.description: Number of adult passengers (12+). Prices on each record are the total for the requested passenger mix.
adults.title: Adults

airlines.description: Only emit itineraries that include at least one of these 2-letter IATA airline codes, e.g. `AA`, `BA`, `DL`.
airlines.title: Include airlines

arriveAfter.description: Keep itineraries whose deplaning arrival is at or after this local time.
arriveAfter.title: Arrive after (HH:MM)

arriveBefore.description: Keep itineraries whose deplaning arrival is at or before this local time.
arriveBefore.title: Arrive before (HH:MM)

cabinClass.description: Requested cabin. `premium-economy` is sent as Skiplagged's `premium` fare class. The real fare class returned by Skiplagged is always included on each record as `fareClass`.
cabinClass.title: Cabin class

calendarDays.description: How many days of the calendar to return, counting from the start date. For round-trip calendars this applies per calendar type (departure and return), so up to twice as many rows can be returned.
calendarDays.title: Calendar days (mode=calendar)

calendarStartDate.description: First date to include in the flexible-date calendar as `YYYY-MM-DD`. Leave blank to start from the earliest returned day.
calendarStartDate.sectionDescription: Options for mode=calendar. The calendar always covers the next 61 days returned by Skiplagged.
calendarStartDate.title: Calendar start date (mode=calendar)

departAfter.description: Keep itineraries whose first departure is at or after this local time, e.g. `08:00`.
departAfter.title: Depart after (HH:MM)

departBefore.description: Keep itineraries whose first departure is at or before this local time, e.g. `22:00`.
departBefore.title: Depart before (HH:MM)

departDate.description: Departure date as `YYYY-MM-DD`. Leave blank to use six weeks from today. Past dates advance to a future month, and a past round-trip gap is preserved.
departDate.title: Departure date

destination.description: Destination airport/metro code (`LHR`, `LON`), Skiplagged city slug (`tokyo`, `dubai-emirate`) or city name (`London`).
destination.title: Destination

destinationAirports.description: Optional exact airports to search instead of `destination`, e.g. `["LHR", "LGW"]`. When set, these override the single destination value (mode=search, byRoutes).
destinationAirports.title: Destination airports

directOnly.description: Only emit nonstop itineraries to the deplaning airport.
directOnly.sectionDescription: Optional filters applied after the search response. Leave them unset or false to keep every itinerary.
directOnly.title: Direct flights only

excludeAirlines.description: Drop itineraries that include any of these 2-letter IATA airline codes.
excludeAirlines.title: Exclude airlines

expandAirports.description: Skiplagged returns at most about 300 itineraries per leg. When on, the actor also searches each airport of the smaller side of a metro route (e.g. JFK, EWR and LGA for NYC) and merges the unique results. Costs a few extra requests (mode=search, byRoutes, byUrls).
expandAirports.title: Expand metro routes for more rows

hiddenCity.description: Include all itineraries, keep only hidden-city fares, or drop hidden-city fares. Hidden-city itineraries end at a different ticketed airport than your destination; check airline baggage and missed-leg rules before booking.
hiddenCity.title: Hidden-city itineraries

includeNearbyAirports.description: Also search airports near the origin and destination (e.g. HPN and ISP around New York). Ignored when an airport list is set (mode=search, byRoutes, byUrls).
includeNearbyAirports.title: Include nearby airports

infantsLap.description: Number of lap infants (under 2, no seat).
infantsLap.title: Infants (on lap)

infantsSeat.description: Number of infants (under 2) with their own seat.
infantsSeat.title: Infants (own seat)

maxDurationMinutes.description: Drop itineraries longer than this many minutes to the deplaning airport, e.g. `600` for 10 hours.
maxDurationMinutes.title: Max duration (minutes)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records for the whole run, across all routes.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxLayoverMinutes.description: Drop itineraries with any layover longer than this many minutes.
maxLayoverMinutes.title: Max layover (minutes)

maxPrice.description: Drop itineraries pricier than this total price in whole USD.
maxPrice.title: Max price (USD)

maxStops.description: Drop itineraries with more stops than this before the deplaning airport. 0 means nonstop.
maxStops.title: Max stops

minPrice.description: Drop itineraries cheaper than this total price in whole USD.
minPrice.title: Min price (USD)

mode.description: What to fetch. `search` uses one origin/destination, `byRoutes` reads the routes array, `byUrls` parses pasted Skiplagged URLs, and `calendar` returns a flexible-date price calendar for one route.
mode.title: Mode

origin.description: Origin airport/metro code (`JFK`, `NYC`), Skiplagged city slug (`new-york`, `tokyo`, `dubai-emirate`) or city name (`New York`). Mode=search and mode=calendar.
origin.sectionDescription: The route searched in mode=search and mode=calendar. Airport codes, metro codes, city names and Skiplagged slugs are accepted.
origin.title: Origin

originAirports.description: Optional exact airports to search instead of `origin`, e.g. `["JFK", "EWR"]`. When set, these override the single origin value (mode=search, byRoutes).
originAirports.sectionDescription: Optional multi-airport and nearby-airport options. Metro codes already cover every airport in the city; these options let you choose specific airports or extend the search area.
originAirports.title: Origin airports

returnDate.description: Return date as `YYYY-MM-DD` for a round-trip search. Leave blank for one-way.
returnDate.title: Return date

routes.description: Batch of routes, one object per route: `{"origin":"NYC","destination":"LON","departDate":"2026-09-01","returnDate":"2026-09-08"}`. `returnDate`, `originAirports` and `destinationAirports` are optional.
routes.sectionDescription: Inputs used by mode=byRoutes and mode=byUrls.
routes.title: Routes (mode=byRoutes)

sortBy.description: Order of emitted records within each route.
sortBy.sectionDescription: Record ordering and the run-wide result cap.
sortBy.title: Sort by

startUrls.description: Skiplagged flight-search URLs, e.g. `https://skiplagged.com/flights/NYC/LON/2026-09-01/2026-09-08`, `https://skiplagged.com/flights/LON/dubai-emirate/2026-09-17` or `https://skiplagged.com/flights/NYC/tokyo/2026-09-17`. Airport codes and multi-word or single-word city slugs are accepted.
startUrls.title: Skiplagged URLs (mode=byUrls)

tripType.description: One-way, round-trip, or auto-detect from whether a return date is present.
tripType.sectionDescription: Cabin and passenger mix are sent to Skiplagged, and the returned itinerary reports the passenger counts and fare class it actually priced.
tripType.title: Trip type

title: Skiplagged Route Fare & Booking Provider Finder Input
